title: Euro-Latin American Parliamentary Assembly to hold 17th plenary session
excerpt: Around 40 MEPs will attend the event in Santa Cruz de Tenerife to discuss trade and global challenges.
bodyHtml:
The European Parliament said on October 23, 2026, that the Euro-Latin American Parliamentary Assembly will hold its 17th plenary session in Santa Cruz de Tenerife on 28-29 October. Around 40 MEPs will attend the plenary, hosted by the Parliament of the Canary Islands.

The agenda includes the protection of multilateralism and Euro-Latin American cooperation, and the promotion of free trade. The parliamentarians will be joined for the discussions by academics, and representatives of international and non-governmental organisations and Canary Islands local and regional authorities.

The opening session on Wednesday will feature the president of the government of the Canary Islands, Fernando Clavijo Battle, and the speaker of the regional parliament, Astrid Pérez. European Parliament president Roberta Metsola and the secretary general of the Ibero-American General Secretariat Andrés Allamand will contribute with video messages.

The EuroLat standing committees will hold meetings on Tuesday 27 October.
